the legend of zelda: ocarina of time - n.description: Become the Hero of Time and save Hyrule from darkness. Take up your sword and embark on a grand adventure! The evil Ganondorf is determined to steal his way into the legendary Sacred Realm, seize the mythical Triforce, and conquer the world. It’s up to you, as the young hero Link, to stop him. Set out with your companion fairy, Navi, on a quest to venture into deadly dungeons, solve puzzles, and collect weapons of great power. You’ll need to travel across time in two different eras to restore balance to Hyrule! A classic tale, built from the ground up for the Nintendo Switch 2 system. This version of the story that first debuted on the Nintendo 64 system features completely overhauled visuals, voiced cutscenes, expanded dialogue, symphonic orchestral music, reworked camera and movement controls, and more. You can even play Link’s in-game ocarina by humming or playing your own instrument using the Nintendo Switch 2 system microphone. This classic tale, reborn on Nintendo Switch 2, is an excellent entry point into the Legend of Zelda series! Get more out of your adventure with ZELDA NOTES on the Nintendo Switch App. Get a little extra support on your quest with ZELDA NOTES—a game-specific service found in the Nintendo Switch App* on compatible smart devices. See your accomplishments for the day, take on the challenge of finding in-game locations based on images, and even play an ocarina on your smart device! Tap any existing Legend of Zelda series amiibo for in-game extras. Get in-game extras to help you on your adventure by tapping any Legend of Zelda series amiibo figure. If you tap the new Young Link and Young Zelda amiibo figures (coming in 2027), you’ll get in-game masks that evoke a retro graphical style!
